requirements.desc: P1: Single source of truth coverage — every instructions_key in context-rules.json maps to a file at src/flow/prompts/<phase>/<step>.md
requirements.note: Implemented prompt files under src/flow/prompts/, added coverage test for missing/orphan detection, and validated key count (updated to 23 actual keys).

requirements.desc: P2: Loader contract — getStepInstructions(key) returns content or throws with key in message
requirements.note: Loader returns UTF-8 content and throws with key for missing/invalid cases, but it does not explicitly validate registration against context-rules.json (it resolves by path).

requirements.desc: P3: CLI returns content — flow get next-action instructions field is { key, content }
requirements.note: get-next-action now returns instructions { key, content } using getStepInstructions; tests were extended for flow/task scopes and content assertions.

requirements.desc: P4: Skill channel reuses the same files via include directives
requirements.note: The three skill templates now replace inline step procedures with include directives to /flow/prompts/... files.

requirements.desc: P5: No content loss during migration — verified by pre/post deployed-skill diff
requirements.note: No concrete pre/post deployed-skill diff artifact proving non-whitespace byte-equality is present in the shown diff.
